rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice for a surface or material that reflects light.

example.english: This jacket has reflective strips, so it’s safer to walk at night.
example.traditional: 呢件外套有反光條，夜晚行街安全啲。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 jau5 faan2 gwong1 tiu4 je6 maan5 haang4 gaai1 on1 cyun4 di1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when looking back makes someone thoughtful or emotional.

example.english: When I look back on those days, I feel reflective.
example.traditional: 我諗返起嗰段日子，真係好感慨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 faan1 hei2 go2 dyun6 jat6 zi2 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 koi3

rows.note: Use this for the quieter meaning of being absorbed in deep thought rather than emotionally looking back.

example.english: They sat by the window, reflective.
example.jyutping: keoi5 co5 hai2 coeng1 cin4 ham6 jap6 cam4 si1
